leanings.option: Milestones are child rows of the phase (subitems, or items on a connected board), each with the milestone in words, the amount, a status of not reached, ready to invoice or invoiced, the invoice date and the Ajera invoice number. The phase shows billed-to-date and the next milestone as roll-ups, and its own status carries work state only, because complete does not mean billed. Billing type sits on the job (Bev's words are 'a milestone job') and is mirrored to its phases; the Consultant's playback put it on each phase, and the level is open. A ready-to-invoice status is the PM's claim that the milestone was hit; the signed letter or the issued set is the evidence, and invoiced is a claim about Ajera until the invoice number is typed in by the person who raised it.
